title: Just updated the word validation and polished UI in my little word game, would love feedback
author: No_Rock5928
selftext:
I’ve been working on a small daily word game where you connect two unrelated things with bridge words.

I just pushed an update to the word validation to make it a bit more forgiving, because before it felt too strict in some cases and rejected paths that felt reasonable.

also updated the UI to be more polished

So now I’m mainly trying to answer:

does it feel better after the update

is it too lenient now

are there still any accepts/rejects that feel obviously wrong

If anyone wants to try it and give blunt feedback, I’d really appreciate it. I’m especially interested in whether the validation feels fair.

Here is the link: [https://playimpossiblepath.com/](https://playimpossiblepath.com/)
